card.name: Just before a rise or fall in levels
card.fires_on: Small words or symbols right before a word like elevated, higher, increase or decrease, mainly in lab-interference or drug-interaction statements (e.g. "falsely", "resulting in", a % sign after a number).

modes.label: Lab test interference
modes.description: Words like falsely or in leading into elevated or high results in assay interference notes.
modes.example: resulting<< in>> falsely elevated estradiol levels.

modes.label: Percent change in drug exposure
modes.description: A percent sign after a number, just before higher or increase in interaction findings.
modes.example: The C max of norethindrone was 13<<%>> higher when it was coadministered

card.writes: It pushes the model to write increase or decrease words and away from words meaning change.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says a level or result went up or down.
